subject: Appeal: expired seed credits - urgent commercial review
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@seedforge.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: SeedForge Billing <billing@seedforge.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to reinstate expired seed credits - SeedForge trial

Hi Markus / Marissa,

Quick context: we were running a concentrated eval of Redwood Inference last month and burned through our seeded credits faster than expected due to heavy batch runs while onboarding a new model. The account (SeedForge / SF-2984) hit its expiration before we could finalize the integration and our engineers are blocked from finishing a final benchmark.

We understand policies around expiry, but this was an honest overrun during the onboarding window. Would Redwood consider a one-time reinstatement of credits (or a short extension of the trial window) to let us complete one last performance run? If feasible, we only need roughly 5k tokens/credits to finish — we expect to be in paid discussions immediately after.

I attached a short usage snapshot (usage_snapshot.csv) showing the burst and the expected remaining runs. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks for considering — Aisha

--
Aisha Patel
Head of ML Ops, SeedForge
aisha@seedforge.ai
From: markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@seedforge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 10:08:53 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to reinstate expired seed credits - SeedForge trial

Thanks for the note, Aisha — and for the usage snapshot.

We want to be reasonable here: happy to explore a one-time accommodation so your engineers can finish the benchmark. Before I commit anything, can you confirm two quick items:

- Which exact project(s)/workspace IDs should receive the credits (so we do not credit the wrong environment)?
- Confirm that the activity is non-production (testing/benchmarking) and that no regulated PII is being processed as part of the runs.

Marissa / Vanessa — looping you both for approval/ops confirmation. If we proceed, I propose we issue a 30-day sandbox top-up with a strict one-time-only policy and updated T&Cs (we'll capture via an amendment). Vanessa, can you check the balance implications and get Compliance to sign off? Marissa, I'd like a sales-side note committing to an immediate next-step meeting with SeedForge to convert to a paid plan once benchmarks are complete.

Markus

--
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 11:34:20 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to reinstate expired seed credits - SeedForge trial

Markus / Vanessa / Rishi — quick internal thread.

On Thu, May 29, 2025 at 9:12 AM Aisha Patel <aisha@seedforge.ai> wrote:
> Quick context: we were running a concentrated eval of Redwood Inference last month and burned through our seeded credits faster than expected due to heavy batch runs while onboarding a new model.

We reviewed the usage file — verified the burst appears legitimate and tied to a single workspace ID (seedforge-prod-eval-1). Compliance flagged no PII markers in the sample.

Operational recommendation: grant a one-time 5,000 credit top-up and extend the trial expiry by 30 days (new expiry 2025-07-01). Terms: this top-up is discretionary, one-off, not precedent-setting. Require signed amendment that: (a) acknowledges the one-time nature, (b) commits to a paid kickoff call within 14 days of completion, and (c) confirms no production traffic.

Finance check: this is sub-$1k NRR-equivalent cost; ops can absorb if we tag the credit to deal SF-2984. Vanessa, please create an internal cost tag and update the ledger. Rishi, please add a note to the deal in HubSpot and book the post-benchmark conversion call with SeedForge (2-week window).

If no objections from Markus / Vanessa / Rishi by EOD Monday, I'll prepare the amendment doc for signature and the credits will be queued.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@seedforge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 15:43:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to reinstate expired seed credits - SeedForge trial

Aisha — thanks for your patience.

We're able to approve a one-time, discretionary 5,000-credit restoration for workspace seedforge-prod-eval-1 and will extend your trial window to 2025-07-01.

Next steps:
- I've attached the amendment (SeedForge_SLA.pdf) and included the usage snapshot for our records (usage_snapshot.csv). Please sign the amendment at the DocuSign link below so we can finalize the change. The amendment reiterates: one-time top-up, no production traffic, and commitment to a conversion call within 14 days of completion.
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC-SeedForge-Amendment
- Once we receive the signed amendment, Ops will apply the credits (should reflect in your console within 1 hour).

Appreciate the clear context and looking forward to the conversion call. Marissa / Rishi — please follow up with scheduling. Vanessa — tagging for cost allocation.

Best —
Markus

Attachments: SeedForge_SLA.pdf (PDF, 18KB) | usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 7KB)
